# HEARTz — Browser-Based Sound Generator & 432 Hz Audio Converter

> Note: This document provides structured, factual summary data intended for automated parsing. It is an optional resource and does not constitute a search engine ranking factor.

## Overview
HEARTz is a client-side web audio application providing tone generation, sound masking, and pitch retuning directly inside modern web browsers. It runs without user registration, external audio processing servers, or telemetry tracking.

## Technical Specifications & Features

### 1. 432 Hz Music Converter
- **Function**: Adjusts the reference pitch of uploaded audio from concert pitch (A4 = 440 Hz) to Verdi tuning (A4 = 432 Hz).
- **Pitch Shift**: -31.767 cents (ratio ~0.981818).
- **DSP Engine**: Client-side resampling and pitch conversion using Web Audio API buffer routines.
- **Export Format**: Lossless uncompressed 16-bit / 48 kHz stereo WAV.
- **Privacy Model**: All decoding, processing, and encoding occur entirely in local browser RAM. No audio data is uploaded to remote servers.

### 2. Frequency Laboratory & Soundscapes
- **Oscillator Types**: Pure sinusoidal tones at user-defined frequencies (including 432.00 Hz and 528.00 Hz).
- **Binaural Signal**: Delivers separate sinusoidal frequencies to left and right channels to produce a perceptual binaural difference tone (e.g., a 7.83 Hz difference over a 432 Hz carrier). Stereo headphones preserve the intended channel separation. Keep the device volume comfortable and stop if listening feels uncomfortable.
- **Sound Masking**: Synthesized brown noise and pink noise filtered to provide broad-spectrum acoustic masking against ambient environmental sounds.

### 3. Client-Side Data Storage
- **Preset Persistence**: User configurations are saved locally via browser IndexedDB.
- **Export/Import**: Settings can be exported and imported as JSON.
- **Tracking / Analytics**: None.
